items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: But you see, when I played with bands like Will Osborne and Elbert Knuck

ctx.x: Yeah. But you see, when I played with bands like Will Osborne and Elbert Knuck, like they had two saxophone players to make an arrangement, the piano player would make an arrangement. Everybody would, you know, get 10, 15 ocks to make a whole arrangement.
